purpose: Optimize and measure remote Codex CPU execution; estimate conditional search allocations; independently calibrate conditional Monte Carlo planning.

cpu_profile.kernel_selection_rule: Require parity evidence. Four cropped workers must complete. For both reference and largest patterns, median whole-worker cropped wall must be at least5% below dense baseline. A wall-censored dense baseline gives a lower bound; other failures block enabling crop. No scores select execution policy.
cpu_profile.optimization_scope: CPU-only algebraically equivalent central crop of padded convolution/fused kernel bank. Parameter objects, shapes, state keys and architecture remain; floating results can differ within registered parity tolerance.
cpu_profile.thread_selection_rule: Use selected kernel policy; require all12 complete. Sum per-model median wall normalized by that model4-thread median. Any thread count within5% of lowest aggregate score ties; choose fewest threads. Incomplete grid retains legacy4 threads and incomplete status. No predictive scores select threads.
cpu_profile.scaling_domain: 6NAS families x12 registered P27 patterns at619 train+83val;6reference patterns at161train+83val;8fixed-body neural references at619train+83val. SAE2epochs eachAE1/AE2/supervised; supervised2epochs for others.
cpu_profile.micro_fallback_rule: Only a scaling resource/time failure permits a separate one-batch throughput profile. Keep original failure and consumed costs. This is not a replacement scientific candidate or an observed full-cohort timing. Implementation/numerical failures block the affected projection.

fixed_recipe.optimizer: AdamW using common fixed betas/epsilon/loss/normalization and epoch rules
fixed_recipe.dropout_non_nas: existing dropout0.1 for TSMixer,iTransformer and neural references;0 for source CNNs
fixed_recipe.dropout_nas: solely declared architecture bits at p0.2
fixed_recipe.scope: Fixed before2023 pilot. Never reuse HPO winners from2024 or2025 and never select candidates on pilot scores. No additional HPO.

cpu_profile.failure_policy: Never replace attempts or hide censored steps; unknown steps remain null. No existing checkpoint or receipt deletion.

preselection_variance.epoch_selection_rule: Five complete fresh fixed-recipe fits per model,200epochcap/patience20;ceil median strict best epochs. Any missing seed blocks all five model refits.
preselection_variance.fresh_refit_rule: Fresh initialization/AdamW/train-only scaler, fixed selected epoch count,no validation input; durable forecast-before-observe and20or30 checkpoints verified with safe load.
preselection_variance.runtime_policy: Selected global thread policy from the frozen independent resource benchmark; same for all three reference models.

calibration.dgp: Fixed observed paired per-seed RMSE differences and common circular date blocks; preserve temporal variation floor and normal-assumption upper seed SD sensitivity. Center all streams at the original observed mean, never their own validation/alternative means.
calibration.critical_rule: One absolute-null statistic critical per R/pair, strict> rejection; design total absolute-tail alpha_pair/2. Binomial order-stat tolerance gamma_cal=.05/(4*observed_pairs).
calibration.null_validation_rule: Independent stream, one-sided ClopperPearson upper at gamma_val=.05/(4*observed_pairs) <= nominal alpha_pair. Do not retune on failure.
calibration.alternative_rule: Independent alternative stream under both +delta and -delta. CP lower gamma_power=.05/(8*observed_pairs). Conditional R requires every observed pair and both signs >=.80 lower bound plus validated null.
calibration.confidence_scope: Separate95% MonteCarlo families for calibration, null validation and alternative validation; no joint95% claim and no claim of final-study power.
calibration.MDE: Descriptive DGP quantile planning only; no postselection CP guarantee.
calibration.analysis_groups: Reanalyse old two-model complete reference panel as historical calibration diagnostic, and separately the new complete3model5seed panel if available. No partial-seed medians; >=2 completely observed models required.

budget_estimation.sampling_design: 3anchor patterns exact plus9 seeded uniform stratum samples among remaining997; HorvitzThompson expansion of predicted costs. Do not average the12 anchors/strata without weights.
budget_estimation.epoch_scenarios: Configured maximum short50/full200, with explicit lower-epoch sensitivity; no observed campaign-wide early-stop mean asserted.
budget_estimation.cost_model: Measure setup/loop/final separately; scale training steps by actual batch counts and add83-date validation per selection epoch. Add setup once per stage. Show measured error/sensitivity for extrapolation, fallback and batch-size assumptions.
budget_estimation.statistical_limits: One sample per stratum cannot identify within-stratum variance or a design-based CI. Predicted cost HT is not unbiased actual elapsed cost if per-model projection error exists.
budget_estimation.storage: Compute exact parameter/state bytes across1000NAS configs; model all-checkpoints and prospective selected-only retention scenarios. Existing outputs are never deleted.
budget_estimation.exclusions: Currency pricing, full diagnostic/robustness/calibration refits, interpretability, inferential runtime and independent environment reproduction; classical timings remain explicit if not measured.

publication: Publish this exact registration and code before new market optimization; preserve every old receipt and checkpoint. New evidence goes in JBook section31.
